'''Jodoo Kreen''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Quermian/Legends|Quermian]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] serving the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] throughout the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], Jodo Kreen was [[Jedi training/Legends|instructed]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] from infancy to the time he passed his [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Trials of Knighthood]] and elevated to the rank of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]. Serving the Order faithfully during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-spanning conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Jedi Kreen took up the rank of [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] within the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] as part of the war effort.<ref name="HSNV" />

Near the end of the war, Jedi Kreen was stationed at the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] when the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] received reports of [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] activity in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant Undercity]]. Sent to investigate, Kreen came across the source of the malicious energy; the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Garth Ezzar]]. Engaging Ezzar in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]], Kreen was overpowered by the darksider and slain. Leaving his body where it lay, Ezzar fled the scene to fight another day. Two weeks later, the [[Heroes of Cularin]] discovered Kreen's decaying corpse as they tracked Ezzar across Coruscant. It was recovered and returned to the Jedi Temple to receive proper [[Jedi funeral/Legends|funeral rites]].<ref name="HSNV" />
